title: Teach it my writing
blurb: Give it something you wrote. It learns the patterns in your words and writes more in the same style.
best_for: Seeing what a trained model actually is — and what a small one cannot do.

asks.label: Drop in something you wrote (or paste it in the app afterwards)

changing: Anything you paste into the page is saved as samples/pasted-writing.txt, so the model keeps learning from it next time.
You can drop .txt files into the samples folder at any time and press Learn again.
The colour is the first line of web/style.css.
The size of the model is the ORDER setting in start.py: 3 means it looks at the last three letters to guess the next one. Bigger is not always better with a small amount of text.

map.run.bat: double-click to start it on Windows
map.run.sh: double-click to start it on macOS or Linux
map.start.py: the tiny model and the training - about 120 lines, commented
map.serve.py: the engine (you never need to open this)
map.web/index.html: the page you paste text into
